Сімейний рецепт»: 300 г свинячих реберець, 3 л води, 2 картоплини, 1 буряк, 1 морква, 1 цибуля, 1/4 капустини, 1 ст. л. томатної пасти, 2 ст. л. олії); https://klopotenko.com/shvydko-ale-tradyczijno-smachno-klasychnyj-borshh-z-tomatno-buryakovoyu-zapravkoyu/ (350–400 г свинини-лопатки, 400 г капусти, 4–5 картоплин, 3 цибулини, 2–3 ст. л. олії, 2,5–3 л води); https://www.unian.ua/recipes/first-courses/borscht/yak-prigotuvati-borshch-tradiciyniy-i-originalni-recepti-10471887.html (УНІАН класичний: 400 г м'яса на кістці, 2 буряки, 3 цибулини, 2 ст. л. томатної пасти, 4–5 ст. л. олії, 300 г капусти, 4 картоплини) and https://www.unian.ua/recipes/first-courses/borscht/nastoyashchiy-slobozhanskiy-borshch-recept-kak-prigotovit-pervoe-blyudo-13384962.html (Слобожанський: 500–700 г м'яса на кістці, ~3 л води, 2 буряки, 4–5 картоплин, 300–400 г капусти, 2–3 ст. л. томатної пасти).
borscht.version: Red borscht on pork broth (pork shoulder/ribs, the commonest home choice; beef is the alternative), 3 L water; beet + carrot + onion + garlic sauteed on sunflower oil and stewed with tomato paste and a pinch of sugar (засмажка, oil counted fully); potato and fresh white cabbage boiled in the broth; meat pieces stay in the soup; dill at the end. Without sour cream. Bay leaf, pepper, salt, a dash of vinegar/lemon omitted (~0 kcal).
borscht.yield_note: Raw batch 4890 g. Simmer ~1.5 h in total (broth ~1 h, then vegetables 30–40 min) with the lid ajar: evaporation ~12 % of the 3000 g water ≈ 360 g, plus ~40 g lost while stewing the beet zasmazhka in the pan → cooked ≈ 4490 g, rounded 4500 g (a typical 5 L pot, ~4.5 L of borscht). Water lost by the meat during boiling stays in the broth, so it is not subtracted. Meat given boneless: 400 g ≈ 520–550 g pork on the bone (ribs/shoulder) minus ~25 % bone. Peeled weights: potato, beet, carrot, onion; cabbage without outer leaves/core.

green-borscht.version: Most typical home version = on PORK broth (chicken broth is the second common variant): pork pieces boiled ~45–60 min, potato, onion + carrot lightly fried on sunflower oil, chopped sorrel and dill added 2–3 min before the end, chopped hard-boiled eggs in the pot / per plate. Without sour cream. Bay leaf, pepper, salt omitted.
green-borscht.yield_note: Raw batch 4200 g. Simmer ~1–1.25 h in total (broth 45–60 min + potato 15–20 min; sorrel only 2–3 min), lid ajar: evaporation ~10 % of 2750 g water ≈ 275 g → 3925 g. Pork boneless: 320 g ≈ average of 300 g boneless (Klopotenko) and 500 g ribs minus ~35 % bone (TSN). Eggs: 200 g = ~3.5–4 boiled eggs without shell (recipes use 3–4). Oil 30 g = average of 0, 2 and 3 tbsp in the three recipes (zasmazhka, counted fully). Sorrel = leaves without stems.

kapusniak.version: Sauerkraut soup on pork broth with millet: pork boiled ~40 min, millet, potato, squeezed sauerkraut simmered ~15 min, onion + carrot + garlic fried on 2 tbsp sunflower oil (counted fully). No tomato, no salo/shkvarky, no sour cream. Bay leaf, pepper, salt omitted.
kapusniak.yield_note: Raw batch 4602 g. Millet absorbs broth but stays in the batch. Pork boneless 350 g = average of 300–400 g boneless and 500 g ribs minus ~30 % bone. Sauerkraut weighed squeezed of brine. Peeled vegetable weights.

chicken-noodle-soup.version: Home chicken soup: chicken legs/half a chicken boiled ~45 min into broth (meat with skin returned to the pot), potato, onion + carrot lightly fried on 1 tbsp sunflower oil, thin egg noodles (локшина/вермішель) added for the last 5–7 min. Bay leaf, pepper, salt omitted.

Chicken: 400 g meat + skin without bone ≈ 2–3 leg quarters / half a chicken of ~600 g minus ~30 % bone. Peeled vegetables. Some cooks do not fry the onion/carrot (then −17 g oil).

Onion 130 g = 40 g grated into the mince + 90 g for the zasmazhka. Egg raw (binder), 1 egg ≈ 55 g. Rice 50 g ≈ 1/4 glass (recipes: 0–100 g); vermicelli would be similar. Oil 25 g ≈ 1.5 tbsp.

pea-soup.version: Split-pea soup on smoked pork ribs: ribs boiled ~30 min, meat taken off the bone and returned, soaked/split peas cooked until soft (~40–60 min), potato, onion + carrot fried on sunflower oil (counted fully), dill. No bacon/sausage, no croutons. Bay leaf, pepper, salt omitted.

Main: https://klopotenko.com/nadzvychajno-smachna-ta-prosta-grybna-yushka-vid-yevgena-klopotenka/ (Грибна юшка з шампіньйонів, Клопотенко: 200 г печериць, 3 картоплини, морква, цибуля, 1 ст. л. олії + 20 г масла, 4-5 ст. л. сметани, 1 ст. л. борошна, 1,5-2 л води). Compared: https://klopotenko.com/gribna-yushka-z-selerou/ (200 г білих грибів, цибуля, 3 картоплі, 1 ст. л. олії, 1 л води); https://vkusvill.ru/media/recipes/sup-iz-sushyenykh-gribov.html (30 г сушених грибів, 2 картоплі, морква, цибуля, 1 ст. л. олії, 2 л води); https://recepty.24tv.ua/recipe/pisna-hrybna-yushka-retsept-pryhotuvannia-pokrokovyi_id625 (100 г сушених білих, 4 картоплі, 2 цибулі, 2 моркви, олія).
mushroom-soup.version: Plain home mushroom soup on water: fresh champignons fried with onion and carrot in sunflower oil (засмажка), potatoes, water, dill/parsley. Sour cream is NOT in the pot (only 1 of 4 recipes puts sour cream + flour + butter into the pot; usually a spoon is added in the bowl and should be logged separately).
mushroom-soup.yield_note: Raw total 2965 g. Losses: champignons fried until their liquid evaporates lose ~35 % (≈110 g), onion/carrot sauté ≈20 g, ~35 min simmer with lid ajar ≈10 % of the 2 L water (≈200 g) → ≈2635 g, rounded 2650 g. Potato weight is peeled; oil of the засмажка counted fully (1.5 tbsp). If dried forest mushrooms are used (~40-50 g dry instead of 300 g fresh) the kcal is almost the same.

references.source: USDA FNDDS 2021-2023, 75649110 Soup, vegetable (closest broth-based proxy; FNDDS has no broth-based mushroom soup)

klopotenko.com, the champignon soup above, states 112 kcal per 100 g (with sour cream + flour + butter in the pot). Looks inconsistent with its own ingredient list (≈900 kcal of ingredients in ≈2.5 kg of soup incl. 1.5-2 L water ≈ 35-40 kcal/100 g) — the site's per-100-g figures for soups seem to leave out most of the water; treat with caution

varenyky-potato.version: Home varenyky on water-egg dough; filling = boiled peeled potato mashed with onion fried in sunflower oil; served tossed with a topping of onion fried in sunflower oil (the commonest home topping; Доцяк/old village version uses salo-shkvarky instead, which is fattier). Dough (all four varenyky types): 500 g flour + ~20 g for dusting, 200 g water, 1 egg, 1 tbsp oil — averaged from TSN (500 g flour, 1 egg, 200 ml water), Klopotenko (360 g flour/180 ml water/2 tbsp oil; 400 g flour/200 ml water/2 tbsp oil) and Доцяк 1998 tech card «Тісто для вареників прісне» (flour 695, egg 53, water 270 per 1000 g dough).
varenyky-potato.yield_note: Oil 102 g = 17 g in dough + 34 g (2 tbsp) frying 100 g filling onion + 51 g (3 tbsp) frying 200 g topping onion; all of it ends up on/in the varenyky (the onion is poured over with its oil), so counted fully. Potato is peeled weight (≈1.05 kg as bought); boiled peeled potato keeps ~its raw weight, drained and mashed. Dough ≈ 790 g + filling ≈ 995 g (900 g potato + 100 g onion fried down to ~60 g + 34 g oil) = ~1785 g raw varenyky; boiled gain +8 % per Доцяк tech card (185 g raw → 200 g boiled) → ~1930 g; + topping (200 g onion fried down to ~110 g + 51 g oil ≈ 160 g) → ≈ 2090 g. shkvarky.recipe_source: Home practice: salo (pork back fat, skin removed) cut in ~1 cm cubes and rendered slowly in a dry pan until golden; the cracklings are lifted out, the liquid fat (smalets) is poured off into a jar. Yield sources: netfreedom.org.ua «Як приготувати здір» https://netfreedom.org.ua/yak-prigotuvati-zdir/ («Вихід: 550–650 мл смальцю + 300–400 г шкварок» from 1 kg); secondary, seen only in search snippets (pages not openable): a Polish home-rendering guide (650–800 g lard per 1 kg raw fat, i.e. ≤200–350 g cracklings + evaporated water) and the Brockhaus–Efron encyclopedia text on booksite.ru https://booksite.ru/fulltext/1/001/007/040/40072.htm (rendering fat trimmings in pieces: 57.7 % fat + 34 % cracklings; minced: 82.5 % fat + 12.5 % cracklings). Доцяк «Українська кухня» (1998) uses shkvarky as a topping (сало 34 г → смажене сало зі шкварками 30 г – that figure INCLUDES the fat, so not used here).
shkvarky.version: The solid crackling bits only (golden, still slightly soft inside), WITHOUT the rendered fat. The rendered fat (smalets) is poured off and is NOT counted.
shkvarky.yield_note: IMPORTANT – fat removal: the rendered fat that is poured off is entered as a NEGATIVE amount of USDA «Lard» (−680 g), the standard recipe-calculation 'fat loss' correction; if the calculator cannot take negative grams, compute kcal = (1000 g × salo − 680 g × Lard) ÷ 250 g. Mass balance for 1000 g backfat (USDA backfat: 88.7 % fat, 7.7 % water, 2.9 % protein): cracklings 250 g (25 % yield) = ~29 g protein + ~208 g fat (≈83 %) + ~12 g water; ~680 g fat poured off; ~65 g water evaporated. Yield basis: 25 % is the middle of the published range for home rendering – 12.5 % (thorough, minced) to 34 % (pieces) in Brockhaus–Efron, 30–40 % for lightly rendered leaf fat (netfreedom), ≤20–35 % implied by the Polish 650–800 g lard per kg. The kcal/100 g is insensitive to the yield chosen (≈770–800 kcal/100 g for 15–35 % yield) because the residue stays mostly fat. Salo with a meat streak gives more protein and fewer kcal.

references.source: USDA FNDDS 2021-2023, 22704010 Pork, cracklings (US cracklings are mostly fried pork SKIN – far more protein, less fat than Ukrainian back-fat shkvarky; lower bound)
Estonian NutriData (TKA), food 777 «Pork, rind, snack / Свиные шкварки, снэк» (61 g protein, 31 g fat – skin-based snack; lower bound, not the same product)

uzvar.recipe_source: Typical home version averaged from: УНІАН https://www.unian.ua/recipes/uzvar-kak-varit-vkusnye-recepty-chto-dobavit-amp-12098481.html (3 л води; сушені яблука 200 г, груші 200 г, чорнослив 100 г, родзинки 100 г, мед 4–5 ст. л.; variant: 600 г сухофруктів + 250 г цукру); Доцяк В.С. «Українська кухня» (1998) «Узвар із сухофруктів»: сухофрукти 100 г, цукор 75 г, мед 25 г, вода 1000 г → вихід 1000 г (https://archive.org/stream/ukrainskakuhnya1998/ukrainskakuhnya1998_djvu.txt); nfront.org.ua https://nfront.org.ua/?p=7293 (300–400 г сухофруктів на 3 л, 4–5 ст. л. меду).
uzvar.version: Dried apples, pears, prunes and raisins simmered ~30 min in water with sugar, left to steep for several hours. Calculated for the WHOLE POT – liquid together with the soaked fruit (NOT strained); a glass of strained liquid is ≈10–20 % lower because the fibre and part of the fruit sugar stay in the fruit.
uzvar.yield_note: Sugar 150 g per 3 L (between the honey-only UNIAN version ~4–5 ст. л. and 250 g in its variant; Dotsiak 75 g sugar + 25 g honey per 1 L is sweeter catering norm). Evaporation ≈150 g (≈5 % of the water in a covered 30-min simmer). 3000 + 500 fruit + 150 sugar − 150 = 3500 g.

kompot.recipe_source: Typical home (summer, cooked in a pot) version averaged from: TSN https://tsn.ua/other/iak-varyty-kompot-3111329.html (на 1 л води 300–400 г фруктів, 50–70 г цукру); УНІАН https://www.unian.ua/recipes/drinks/sweet-drinks/kompot-z-vishni-p-yatihvilinka-i-inshi-recepti-11888970.html (на 3-л банку: вишня 800 г, цукор 300 г; summer version boiled in a pot 5–7 min).
kompot.version: Fresh apples and (pitted) sour cherries put into boiling sugared water, simmered 5–10 min, left to cool under a lid. Calculated for the WHOLE POT (liquid + fruit, not strained). A winter compote from a 3-L jar is denser (≈800 g fruit + 300 g sugar per jar) – about 45–55 kcal/100 g.
kompot.yield_note: Apple cored (≈450 g as bought); cherries pitted weight (≈390 g with stones). Sugar 200 g per 3 L = 67 g/L (TSN 50–70 g/L). Evaporation during a 5–10 min simmer ≈60 g ⇒ 3000 + 750 + 200 − 60 = 3890 g. Strained liquid is only slightly lower (≈5 %): the sugar is dissolved evenly, fresh fruit holds little extra.
